meta.name: repo-intake-and-plan
meta.description: Rigor Intake helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to scan a repository, read the README and common project files, extract documented commands, classify inference, evaluation, and training candidates, and return the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the main orchestrator. Do not use for environment setup, asset download, command execution, final reporting, paper lookup, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍仓库的说明与配置文件,列出一份最靠谱的最小复现步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个开源深度学习仓库,想先弄清怎么跑起来再动手
copy.tagline_en: Scan a repo's docs and files, then list the shortest reproduction steps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an open-source deep learning repo and want to know how to run it.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描指定仓库，读 README 和常见项目文件，列出文档里写明的命令，把候选任务分成推理、评测、训练等类别，并给出最小可信复现方案。它只做扫描和规划，不装环境、不下载资源、不执行命令。
howto.when: 在 README 优先的复现工作开始时触发；主技能需要快速了解仓库结构与已有命令时也会调用；用户想先看仓库、暂不运行任何东西时同样适用。

say.text: 先扫一遍这个仓库，把 README 里写明的命令列出来
say.note: 只扫描和整理，不执行任何命令

say.text: 把仓库里的候选任务分成推理、评测、训练，给我最小复现方案
say.note: 输出分类候选与最小可信方案

say.text: 我只想先看看仓库结构，先别跑任何东西
say.note: 给出结构摘要与风险点清单

howto.what_en: Once installed, it scans the target repo, reads the README and common project files, lists documented commands, sorts candidates into inference, evaluation, training and other, and returns the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan. It only scans and plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of README-first reproduction, when the main skill needs a quick map of repo structure and documented commands, or when the user wants to inspect the repo without running anything.

say_en.text: Scan this repo first and list the commands the README documents.
say_en.note: Scan and plan only; nothing is executed.

say_en.text: Classify its candidates into inference, evaluation, training, and give the smallest plan.
say_en.note: Returns classified candidates and a minimum plan.

say_en.text: Just show me the repo structure for now, don't run anything.
say_en.note: Returns a structure summary and risk list.
